patch.summary: Save recruiter edits to skills, years, degree and fields
patch.description: Only the fields sent change. `skills`, when sent, replaces the job's whole skill list: each chip names a skill by `skill_id`, or by `name` (canonical or alias); an unknown name adds a custom skill. Existing scores for the job are marked stale.

post.summary: Upload 1-50 resumes (PDF or DOCX) for a job
post.description: Returns at once with the batch id. Each valid file is stored and parsed in the background; poll the batch for progress. Invalid files are listed under `rejected` with a reason and are not part of the batch.

get.description: Poll this every couple of seconds until `status` is no longer `processing`. Failed files carry a reason in `parse_error`.

post.description: Optionally saves new `weights` first. Rescoring replaces earlier results.

CandidateOut.title: CandidateOut
CandidateOut.description: Everything the candidate page shows, read from what scoring stored.

DegreeLevel.title: DegreeLevel
DegreeLevel.description: Stored as SMALLINT 0-5 with a CHECK constraint, so levels can be compared with >=.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional; otherwise read from the JD's first line or label

unmapped_skills.title: Unmapped Skills
unmapped_skills.description: JD skill-list items not in the taxonomy

top_score.title: Top Score
top_score.description: Best match %, once resumes are scored

weights.description: Saved on the job before scoring

is_stale.title: Is Stale
is_stale.description: The job's requirements changed since this was scored

message.title: Message
message.description: A reason to show the recruiter

RequirementsUpdate.title: RequirementsUpdate
RequirementsUpdate.description: Recruiter edits. Only the fields sent are changed; `skills` replaces the whole list.

Seniority.title: Seniority
Seniority.description: Read from a JD title (design doc §5.4). Kept in jobs.parsed_json; there is no column.

SkillAddedBy.title: SkillAddedBy
SkillAddedBy.description: Who attached a skill to a job. Stored as VARCHAR(10) + CHECK, per the design doc.

SkillCategory.title: SkillCategory
SkillCategory.description:
Taxonomy categories. Related-skill credit (tier 3) only flows within one category,
so categories are deliberately narrower than "tool" or "framework" alone.

name.title: Name
name.description: Canonical name or alias; an unknown name adds a custom skill

category.description: Only used when `name` creates a custom skill (default: tool)

SkillRequirementIn.title: SkillRequirementIn
SkillRequirementIn.description: One skill chip: an existing skill (by id or name/alias) or a new custom one.

Weights.title: Weights
Weights.description: Relative weights: each >= 0, at least one above 0. They need not sum to 1.

scored.title: Scored
scored.description: Resumes rescored with the new weights
